description: This PHP class defines a report model for subscriptions in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for retrieving subscription data with filtering and grouping options, as well as calculating total subscriptions based on filters.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for generating subscription reports, including methods to get subscription data and total count, with options for filtering and grouping.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves subscription records grouped by selected period, with optional filters for status and date range, returning an array of subscription statistics.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Calculates total number of subscription records based on filters and grouping criteria, returning a count.
